rules.title: 📜 Server rules
rules.intro: Welcome to **{server}**! To keep it a great place for everyone, please follow these rules. The team may act on anything that breaks their spirit.

s.1: **Respect everyone.** No insults, harassment, hate speech, discrimination or threats.
s.2: **No spam or flooding.** No repeated messages, walls of text, caps lock or mass mentions.
s.3: **Keep it safe for work.** No NSFW, gore or shocking content – anywhere, including avatars and nicknames.
s.4: **No advertising.** Promoting servers, channels or services is allowed only through partnerships.
s.5: **Use the right channels.** Stay on topic and use bot commands in the bot channel.
s.6: **No cheating or exploits.** Don't share, promote or ask for cheats, hacked clients or exploits.
s.7: **Protect privacy.** Don't share anyone's personal data, including your own passwords and codes.
s.8: **No scams or trading outside the rules.** Trades happen at your own risk – report scams to the team.
s.9: **Listen to the staff.** If you disagree with a decision, open a ticket instead of arguing in public.
s.10: **Follow Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.** discord.com/terms · discord.com/guidelines

rules.footer: Breaking the rules leads to a warning, timeout, kick or ban, depending on how serious it is. Thank you for keeping the community friendly! 💜

start.title: 👋 Welcome to {server}!
start.intro: Glad to have you here! Here's how to get started:

step.1: Read the rules – they keep the place friendly.
step.2: Verify with the button to unlock the server.
step.4: Say hi in the general chat and introduce yourself.
step.5: Need help? Open a ticket in the support channel – we're happy to help.

q.4: Does it work with non-premium accounts?
q.7: How do I suggest a feature?
q.8: How can I join the team?

a.1: A Minecraft client with a PvP/QoL mod built in (HUD, wardrobe, radial menu) and Nore Launcher, which installs and starts the game in one click.
a.2: On {website} – pick your system and run the installer.
a.3: Yes, Nore Client and Nore Launcher are free.
a.4: Yes – both premium (Microsoft) and non-premium (nickname) accounts work.
a.5: Many versions on Fabric and Forge – the launcher shows which ones are available.
a.6: Check the known issues channel, then open a ticket or post in the help forum with your logs.
a.7: Use /suggest or the suggestions channel – everybody can vote.
a.8: Watch the join-the-team channel – when applications are open, click the button there.

req.2: No NSFW, cheats or scam content.

req.3: Good communication and calm under pressure.
req.4: Knowledge of the rules and of Nore.

staffapp.how: Click the button below and answer a few questions. Every application is read.

beta.text: Beta testers get new versions first. Beta builds can be unstable – back up your worlds and report every bug in the beta bugs forum. Please don't share beta builds outside this category.

support.title: 🎫 Support
support.text: Need help? Pick a category in the panel below – a private ticket will be opened for you and the team. Please describe the problem in as much detail as possible.

changelog.title: 📝 Changelog
changelog.text: Every change to the server is posted here. Format: **version / date** – list of changes. Follow this channel to get updates on your own server.

announcement.title: The server is open!
announcement.body: Welcome to **{server}**! Read the rules, verify and pick your roles. Have fun and invite your friends!

i.1: Be calm, polite and fair – you represent the team.
i.2: Always give a reason for an action; it goes to the mod log automatically.
i.3: Prefer a warning or a timeout before a kick or ban.
i.4: Claim a ticket before answering it and close it with a short summary.
i.5: Discuss doubtful cases in the mod chat before acting.
i.6: Never share internal information outside the staff channels.

bugs.title: 🐞 How to report a bug
bugs.text:
1. Search the forums first – maybe it's already reported.
2. One post per bug with a clear title.
3. Add your system, Minecraft version and Nore version.
4. Describe the steps to reproduce and attach logs or screenshots.

We tag reports as **Confirmed** and **Fixed** when they're handled.

appeals.title: ⚖️ Ban appeals
appeals.text: Banned in game? Open a ticket with the **Ban appeal** category. Give your nickname, the date and why you think the ban should be lifted. Be honest – appeals are reviewed by someone other than the person who banned you.

events.title: 📅 Events
events.text: We regularly run events, tournaments and giveaways. Pick the events ping in the roles channel to never miss one. Seasonal Nore events (Halloween, winter) are announced automatically.

market.title: 🔄 Trading rules
market.text:
• One offer per message, with the price.
• No scams – reported scammers are banned.
• Use the middleman service of the staff for big trades.
• Trading real money is not allowed.

international.title: 🌍 International
international.text: We have chats in Polish and English. Any other language is welcome here – please keep the main chats in their language.
